questions.question: Choose the correct relation(s): (i) √15 < 3.8 (ii) √20 > 4.5 (iii) √24 < 5
questions.questionHtml:
Choose the correct relation(s):

(i) √15 < 3.8
(ii) √20 > 4.5
(iii) √24 < 5
questions.solution:
(i) √15 < 3.8
Square both sides:
√15 < 3.8
15 < 3.8 × 3.8
15 < 14.44

This is false.
So, √15 > 3.8

(ii) √20 > 4.5
Square both sides:
√20 > 4.5
20 > 4.5 × 4.5
20 > 20.25

This is false.
So, √20 < 4.5

(iii) √24 < 5
Square both sides:
√24 < 5
24 < 5 × 5
24 < 25

This is true.

Answer: Only (iii) is correct.

questions.question: A sum of money invested at compound interest doubles itself in 4 years. In how many years will it become eight times itself at the same rate of interest?
questions.questionHtml: A sum of money invested at compound interest doubles itself in 4 years. In how many years will it become eight times itself at the same rate of interest?
questions.solution:
Money becomes double in 4 years.

To become 8 times:

8 = 2 × 2 × 2

So, it needs 3 doublings.

Time = 4 × 3 = 12 years

questions.question: Two friends, Rahul and Rohan, start walking from the same point at speeds of 6 km/h and 9 km/h respectively, in the same direction. What will be the distance between them after 3 hours?
questions.questionHtml: Two friends, Rahul and Rohan, start walking from the same point at speeds of 6 km/h and 9 km/h respectively, in the same direction. What will be the distance between them after 3 hours?
questions.solution:
Same direction distance = Difference of speeds × Time

Difference of speeds = 9 - 6 = 3 km/h

Distance between them after 3 hours = 3 × 3 = 9 km

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio 7 : 4. If the difference between them is 18, find the numbers.
questions.questionHtml: Two numbers are in the ratio 7 : 4. If the difference between them is 18, find the numbers.
questions.solution:
Let the numbers be 7x and 4x.

Difference = 18
7x - 4x = 18
3x = 18
x = 6

So, the numbers are:

7x = 7 × 6 = 42
4x = 4 × 6 = 24

Answer: 42 and 24

questions.question: A rectangular garden has an area equal to a square playground. If the rectangular garden measures 121 m in length and 49 m in breadth, find the perimeter of the square playground.
questions.questionHtml: A rectangular garden has an area equal to a square playground. If the rectangular garden measures 121 m in length and 49 m in breadth, find the perimeter of the square playground.
questions.solution:
Area of rectangle = Length × Breadth
= 121 × 49
= 5929 m²

Area of square = 5929 m²

Side of square = √5929
= 77 m

Perimeter of square = 4 × Side
= 4 × 77
= 308 m

questions.question: A trader buys a set of 4 identical cycles at a total cost of Rs. 20,000. He sells them at Rs. 5,200, Rs. 4,800, Rs. 5,500, and Rs. 4,900 respectively. What is the overall profit or loss?
questions.questionHtml: A trader buys a set of 4 identical cycles at a total cost of Rs. 20,000. He sells them at Rs. 5,200, Rs. 4,800, Rs. 5,500, and Rs. 4,900 respectively. What is the overall profit or loss?
questions.solution:
Total cost price = Rs. 20,000

Total selling price = 5,200 + 4,800 + 5,500 + 4,900
= Rs. 20,400

Profit = Selling Price - Cost Price
= 20,400 - 20,000
= Rs. 400

Answer: Overall profit of Rs. 400

questions.question: Anil and Sunil together can complete a project in 10 days. Anil alone can finish the same project in 15 days. In how many days can Sunil alone finish the project?
questions.questionHtml: Anil and Sunil together can complete a project in 10 days. Anil alone can finish the same project in 15 days. In how many days can Sunil alone finish the project?
questions.solution:
LCM of 10 and 15 = 30

So, total work = 30 units

Anil + Sunil’s 1 day work = 30 ÷ 10 = 3 units

Anil’s 1 day work = 30 ÷ 15 = 2 units

Sunil’s 1 day work = 3 - 2 = 1 unit

Time taken by Sunil alone = 30 ÷ 1 = 30 days

questions.question: Two right prisms have the same height of 12 cm. One has a regular triangular base with a side length of 8 cm, and the other has a regular hexagonal base with a side length of 4 cm. What is the ratio of the volume of the triangular prism to the volume of the hexagonal prism?
questions.questionHtml: Two right prisms have the same height of 12 cm. One has a regular triangular base with a side length of 8 cm, and the other has a regular hexagonal base with a side length of 4 cm. What is the ratio of the volume of the triangular prism to the volume of the hexagonal prism?
questions.solution:
Since the height is the same,

Volume ratio = Base area ratio

Regular triangle area ∝ side²
Regular hexagon area = 6 × equilateral triangle area of the same side

So, ratio = 8² : 6 × 4²
= 64 : 96
= 2 : 3

questions.question: Consider two triangles, ΔPQR and ΔXYZ. It is stated that these two triangles are congruent to each other, which is denoted as: ΔPQR ≅ ΔXYZ If the measure of ∠Q = 75°, what is the measure of ∠Y?
questions.questionHtml: Consider two triangles, ΔPQR and ΔXYZ. It is stated that these two triangles are congruent to each other, which is denoted as: ΔPQR ≅ ΔXYZ If the measure of ∠Q = 75°, what is the measure of ∠Y?
questions.solution:
In congruent triangles, corresponding angles are equal.

Given:
ΔPQR ≅ ΔXYZ

So, the corresponding vertices are:

P ↔ X
Q ↔ Y
R ↔ Z

Therefore, ∠Q = ∠Y

∠Q = 75°
So, ∠Y = 75°
